Subject: Discovery recap + priority check — QuantumPay

Hi Sophie / Eva,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the open conversation about where QuantumPay is headed this year. Quick recap and a suggested next step so we can stay aligned: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary objective: reduce invoice processing latency and lower per-transaction enrichment cost for disputed transactions (target: 50% token cost reduction).
- KPIs: average end-to-end enrichment latency < 250ms, cost per 10k lookups <= $X (you mentioned current spend is a blockage).
- Security: must support VPC/private deployment and SOC2-compliant logging for finance data.

Proposed next step
- 3-week pilot (1 GPU pool) to validate throughput/latency on a 2TB dataset sample + audit log proof-of-concept.
- Timeline: pilot start in August, ramp to production in Q4 if fit.
- Deliverables: performance report, cost projection, and short runbook for integration.

I've attached a one-pager that distills the pilot scope and a tentative mutual action plan (attachment: quantumpay-discovery-recap-20250710.pdf).

Question for you
- Is this pilot still on the roadmap for July/August? If priorities shifted, what timeline should we be thinking about?

If it helps, I can block 30 minutes next week to walk through the pilot milestones with your infra and security folks.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Would love just a one-line signal (green/amber/red) on whether this should stay on the agenda, move to Q4, or be parked.

Thanks!
Laura

Marcus — forwarding the thread. No response yet after the bump. QuantumPay has the kind of flow that could be high-volume but requires private deployment and audit logs (SOC2).

My thoughts:
- Offer: 3-week pilot with a single dedicated GPU node + access to our private deployment checklist.
- Incentive: include a one-off pilot credit (covering infra for the pilot) to remove the procurement blocker.

Would you be comfortable approving a $5k pilot credit if they signal interest? If not, what do you suggest as the standard escalation?

Thanks — will hold off on further nudges until I hear back.

Laura

Hi Laura — thanks for the follow-up and for the tidy recap. Apologies for the delay, we've been sorting priorities across a few initiatives. Short update and some feedback: 

Status
- We're deprioritizing new vendor pilots for the remainder of July and most of August due to an internal platform migration and headcount shifts.
- That means we won't be able to kick off a pilot in the August window you suggested.

Feedback
- The scope in the one-pager looks sensible and addresses our main concerns (latency and auditability).
- The VPC/private deployment is a hard requirement — good to see that's on the table.

Next step
- Can we tentatively plan to revisit in early September? If so, please send available 30-minute slots for the first two weeks of September and we'll pick one.

Thanks again — we appreciate the clarity in the recap.

Best,
Sophie
